v3-codex-provenance.rubric: Every source-code edit in every unit commit traces to a codex:codex-rescue task whose forwarded flags were exactly --model <U1-pinned GPT-5.6 Sol identifier> --effort high --write --wait. FAIL and re-run the unit if any task ran with a different model, a different effort, or defaulted either flag; silent fallback to another model is a contract violation, not a recoverable warning. FAIL if Fable itself authored any source edit (orchestrator-only rule): the only files Fable may write are plans/README.md, docs/loops/**, and commit metadata. Worst case to catch: a Codex CLI that rejects the model string and silently runs its default model.

v4-diff-boundaries.rubric: Per unit: the diff touches only the Files listed in that unit's source plan; every Boundaries bullet holds (no new dependencies; no drag-to-dismiss on the Settings grabber; data-settings-page preserved; scale 0.985 only on cards; no AnimatePresence between ScanSheet steps; cascade only when isNewBean; no haptics on error paths; tasting wizard untouched); the plan's verbatim excerpts are the drift authority, not the ec777a5 stamp; a Codex STOP-on-drift report halts the unit and is surfaced, never improvised around. Worst case to catch: an edit bleeding into the pre-existing wip-baseline hunks in SettingsPage.jsx or TastingTab.jsx — revert and re-task fresh.

v6-device-signoff.prompt: Tal confirms on his iPhone (dev-channel bundle from /ship-dev, label reported in Settings OTA line) the risk-ordered checklist: Settings sheet visible after 5 consecutive opens (R1, the WKWebView gate); Ruphus close with iOS Reduce Motion ON dismisses within ~300ms (R5 timeout fallback); Ruphus exit symmetry (R5); haptics on scan-save (R2), tasting save, bag finish, star taps, paywall sandbox (R3); new-bean cascade (R2); Quick Recipe menu pop-in (R6); ScanSheet steps (R7); card presses (R4); Reduce Motion pass across remaining surfaces. This is the terminal gate proving R12.

goal.definition_of_done: All seven plans landed as their own commits on the fresh branch, every edit authored by a codex:codex-rescue task run with the pinned GPT-5.6 Sol model at effort high (never any other model or effort), every unit diff verified within its source plan's Boundaries by Fable, npm run build green at HEAD, wip-baseline and plans/ commits at the branch root, plans/README.md statuses updated with no TODO remaining, /ship-dev completed with the -devapp bundle label reported and the risk-ordered device checklist delivered to Tal. Terminal acceptance beyond the loop: Tal's on-device sign-off.
goal.statement: Execute the seven self-contained animation plans in plans/ (repo root) as one coordinated run on a fresh branch: SettingsPage sheet presentation, scan-save arrival, success-feedback wiring, card press feedback, Ruphus slide-up exit, Quick Recipe menu pop-in, and ScanSheet step transitions. Claude Fable 5 orchestrates ONLY (preflight, spawning, diff review, builds, commits, README statuses, ship, final review) and never writes or edits source code. Every implementation edit is made by a Codex subagent (GPT-5.6 Sol, effort high), one fresh agent per unit, serial order U1..U9.

scope_guard: Only the seven plans' changes; no new animation decisions, no scope additions, no cleanup of adjacent code.
Pre-existing changes are parked in the wip(pre-existing-baseline) root commit — never edited, never mixed into an animation commit (exception - the plans/ directory is committed in U1).
Fable never writes or edits source code; all implementation edits come from Codex tasks.
No production ship; /ship-dev only. Merging waits for Tal's device sign-off.
Deferred items stay deferred (jar-slot enter/exit, EditBeanModal accordions, empty-state fadeUp; the plan-001 CSS fallback rework is its own follow-up if the device gate fails).
